name: Jet Stream
description: Long thin strokes laid end to end along a slow, smooth current, so the sheet reads as a wind map of streaming lines.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { --a: @rn(-60, 220, 0.9); :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -34%; top: 45%; width: 168%; height: 10%; border-radius: 99px; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transform: rotate($deg(a)); transform: rotate($deg(a)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
